evidence: Implementation workflow owns worker/pathfinder handoff, validation loop, review gate, and finalization.
Proposal workflow needs a mandatory auditor completion gate after deterministic validation.
Plan workflow needs auditor/fallback consistency before handoff readiness.
Pathfinder is the project-specific implementation child whose output contract should prevent parent rework.
Auditor is the semantic gate that should be required before completion when available.
Compass should advise after repeated subagent/tool failures or timeout ambiguity.
Drafter should remain a drafting-only role and not become the final completion validator.
Session analyzer should produce accurate future evidence for timeout/error diagnostics.
Analyzer behavior should be covered by unit tests.
Workflow documentation expectations should be locked by tests.
README should explain hardened subagent workflow guarantees.
Package scripts define candidate validation commands for implementation phases.
Implement workflow should dispatch project-specific phase edits to pathfinder by default.
Implement workflow should require deterministic validation receipts and semantic auditor pass before phase/final completion.
Proposal completion should require auditor or explicit fallback receipt after validate-topic passes.
Plan completion should require auditor or explicit fallback receipt after planning graph validation passes.
Repeated worker/tool failures or timeout loops should trigger compass before serial parent takeover.
Analyzer changes should update synthetic session tests.
